create_accuracy_meter: create an AccuracyMeter instance with a list of top-k values for classification accuracy tracking
update_accuracy_meter: update the AccuracyMeter with model output logits and target labels to track correct predictions
sync_accuracy_meter_state: sync the AccuracyMeter state across distributed workers using all_reduce_sum for aggregated totals
get_accuracy_value: get the current top-k accuracy values as a dictionary from the AccuracyMeter value property
reset_accuracy_meter: reset the AccuracyMeter to zero out all correct prediction counts and sample counts
